mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO feed_impressions (user_id, item_type, item_id, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, seen_count, max_dwell_ms, opened) VALUES
(#{userId}, #{item.type}, #{item.id}, NOW(), NOW(), 1, #{item.dwellMs}, #{item.opened})
ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_type, item_id) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = NOW(), seen_count = LEAST(feed_impressions.seen_count + 1, 32000), max_dwell_ms = GREATEST(feed_impressions.max_dwell_ms, EXCLUDED.max_dwell_ms), opened = feed_impressions.opened OR EXCLUDED.opened
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM feed_impressions WHERE ctid IN ( SELECT ctid FROM feed_impressions WHERE last_seen_at < #{cutoff} LIMIT #{limit})
